To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the oxidation behaviour of Ni22 Cr10AlY in sulphur-containing atmospheres at 1173–1273 K depends on the alloy porosity and grain size, the reaction temperature and the SO 2 concentration in the atmosphere.

the oxidation rate of Ni-Cr-Al-Y alloys decreases with decreasing reaction temperature, and that the oxide scales formed during exposure in SO 2 at temperatures of 1273 and 1173 K have complex microstructures and composition.
Ni22Cr10Aly-alloy oxidized in sulphur-containing atmospheres at 1173 K and above forms complex oxides, with a composition of NiCr 2 O 4, NiCrO 2 and NiAl 2 O 3.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the corrosion behaviour and microstructure of Ni22CrAlY alloys in SO 2 atmosphere.
the influence of porosity, grain size and reaction temperature on the corrosion behaviour of bond coat Ni 22Cr10Al alloy in sulphur-containing atmospheres.
the corrosion of bond coat Ni-Cr-Al-Y alloys in sulphur-containing environment and the effect of sulphur on the corrosion behaviour of these alloys.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the oxidation of the bond coat Ni22AlCrY-alloy is strongly dependent on the alloy microstructure and the reaction temperature.
the Ni22Cr10 AlY alloy is not suitable as the bond coat in SO 2 -containing atmospheres.

the corrosion behaviour of the Ni22Cr10 AlY alloys is very complex, depending on the type of alloy, temperature and time of oxidation, as well as on the type and concentration of the sulphur compounds in the gas phase.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the oxidation behaviour of Ni22 Cr 10 AlY alloys in SO 2 depends not only on the type of alloy but also on the reaction temperature.
the corrosion behaviour of the Ni22Cr10A1Y alloys is strongly influenced by the type and size of the grains.
the oxidation of Ni22AlCrY alloys in SO 2 is a complicated process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the oxidation of Ni22AlCrY bond coat in a SO 2 atmosphere is a complex process, which depends on the alloy structure.
the Ni22Cr10 AlY-alloy can be successfully applied as bond coat in thermal protection systems.

the oxidation behaviour of Ni22AlCrY alloys in SO2 is strongly dependent on the alloy’s microstructure and that the oxidation behaviour in the temperature range of 1173 to 1273 K is different from the behaviour in the temperature interval of 973 to 1073 K.
